jobs.title: AI Research Intern – Predictive World Model
jobs.description_text: XPENG is a leading smart technology company at the forefront of innovation, integrating advanced AI and autonomous driving technologies into its vehicles, including electric vehicles (EVs), electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and robotics. With a strong focus on intelligent mobility, XPENG is dedicated to reshaping the future of transportation through cutting-edge R&D in AI, machine learning, and smart connectivity. We are seeking PhD research interns with strong expertise in generative modeling and a demonstrated record of original research. jobs.title: Learning Scientist
jobs.description_text: About LearnVector For most of history, great teaching has been scarce. A brilliant teacher who knows you well, adapts to how you learn, and patiently stays with you until you get there — almost no one has had that. AI changes what's possible. LearnVector, founded by Andrew Ng, is building a trustworthy AI guide for learning, with a mission to accelerate human development. We're a small, fast-moving team working on-site in Mountain View, California and backed by a $100 million investment from Coursera. About the role You will invent new ways to teach that take advantage of agentic AI — and apply rigorous measurement to prove they work. Agentic AI makes teaching moves possible that no classroom or MOOC could offer: a tutor that remembers everything, infinitely patient practice, feedback on real work product, assessment woven invisibly into learning. Most of these possibilities are unexplored, and much of what's shipping across the industry today has no evidence behind it. Your job is both halves: design the new methods, and hold them to the standard of evidence. What did the learner retain a week later? Can they apply it to work that looks nothing like the exercise? You'll be the person in the company whose answer to "is this teaching?" is a measurement, not an opinion. What you will do - Invent and prototype AI-native teaching methods — working with engineers to build them into the product, not writing papers about what could be built - Design the company's measurement backbon

jobs.description_text: Are you a true Salesforce Trailblazer - the kind of admin who lights up at a workflow problem and can't help but tinker until it's just right? Are you just as comfortable putting Claude and other AI tools to work, turning tedious documentation and reporting into a five-minute job? We're a small, passionate, and pretty fun crew sitting right at the heart of FireMon's go-to-market strategy - and we can't wait to meet you. As our Salesforce Admin, you'll own day-to-day user management, work closely with the entire GTM org (Sales/Marketing/Finance/CS), and recommend best practices, all while keeping our CRM integrations running smoothly. You're a natural communicator who can turn business needs into clean, scalable systems - and you know how to pair your Salesforce chops with AI tools like Claude to get more done, faster. We're looking for candidates based in the Central or Eastern time zone so you can overlap with our Revenue Operations and Sales/Marketing stakeholders around the globe.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. The Accounting Manager will report directly to the CFO and advise executive leadership on critical financial decisions. Initially, this role will require a significant amount of hands-on work, but with ample prospects for progress and growth over time. Main responsibilities will include month end close, budget, variance analysis, auditing, income tax, international consolidation, financial reporting, ERP system integration, and implementing scalable systems and processes to support our continued expansion. The successful candidate will have experience managing accounting, tax, and FP&A in an international and production environment and an eagerness to solve challenging problems, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, and regulations in a dynamic environment.

jobs.title: E-Space 2027 Summer Internship, Arlington TX
jobs.description_text: As a company, E-Space does not believe in sticking to the path that has already been trodden. We are encountering new problems every day that need new ways of thinking. At E-Space, we use a first principles approach to solving tough technical challenges, and we look at problems differently. Most aerospace internships hand you one project, one team, and a report-out slide at the end of summer. E-Space is different: we’re a vertically integrated space company building spacecraft manufacturing capability from the ground up in Arlington, TX, and we’re writing the playbook, rather than following someone else’s. That means our interns aren’t boxed into a single lane. Our previous interns have worked across multiple disciplines in a single cohort, pitched and built their own passion projects, and watched ideas they proposed become hardware that flies, not something that gets shelved after a final presentation. If you want the mission and scale of a rapidly scaling aerospace and defense company without layers of process that come with it, this is where you should build it yourself!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description_text: Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync. At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning. Reporting to the Sales Director, you'll own a named account list with some of the country's largest banks and credit unions. These institutions know who we are as Greenlight is the market leader in a rapidly growing youth and family banking category. Many have been in conversation with us. jobs.title: Program Manager (Bilingual Japanese/English)
jobs.description_text: PlusAI is a Physical AI company pioneering AI-based virtual driver software for factory-built autonomous trucks. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next-generation autonomous trucks. If you’re ready to make a huge impact and drive the future of autonomy, Plus is looking for talented individuals to join its fast-growing teams. About the role: PlusAI is looking for a Program Manager to serve as the day-to-day owner of Japan-based programs — the connective tissue between our Japanese partners and PlusAI's engineering, product, and operations teams in the Bay Area. This role is based in the Bay Area with regular, though not full-time, travel to Japan (approximately 25%). Japanese fluency is required, since you will be operating as a trusted, direct point of contact for partner teams who communicate primarily in Japanese.

jobs.title: Direct Marketing Manager (Credit Card & Creative Strategy)
jobs.description_text: Your Role in Our Mission Prosper is seeking a Direct Marketing Manager to lead creative strategy, campaign testing, and full end-to-end production execution for our Credit Card direct mail portfolio. Reporting directly to the Director of Direct Mail Strategy & Analytics, you will take direct ownership of our Credit Card direct response engine, working alongside our Senior Manager to manage our growing direct mail footprint and scale nationwide promotions for our flagship Credit Card Products. We are looking for an innovative, data-driven marketer who blends creative strategy with rigorous production execution. In this role, you will not only drive creative testing and hyper-personalized messaging strategies, but also manage complex variable print matrix execution, print vendor relationships, proofing, and on-time campaign deployment. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $148,000 - $184,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits. In determining your salary, we will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

jobs.title: Director, Operations Analytics & Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: Your Role In Our Mission The Director of Operations Analytics & Infrastructure leads three core functions in Ops: Analytics, Data Science, and Systems Infrastructure. Leading a total team of 24 across 4 direct reports in Phoenix, San Francisco, and remote locations, you will leverage data analytics, AI, and automation to drive business efficiency. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will oversee core software infrastructure (Zendesk, LiveVox, NICE CXone) while ensuring system reliability, data governance, and regulatory compliance. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $208k - $258k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits. In determining your salary, we will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.
